counting: One record per saved proposal, variant or platform use. Density exports and adaptive layers belong to the parent record. The current launcher also has a Round 3 source record.

records.title: Kairouan Shadow
records.description: A Kairouan minaret casts a long terracotta shadow. The tower gives the icon a place and its moving shadow suggests time.

records.title: Woven Hour
records.description: A turned corner shows the golden reverse of a prayer rug. Its stepped niche and broad fringe give the textile a recognizable outline.

records.title: Quiet Frequency
records.description: Two sound waves rise into a prayer arch and settle into a level line. The phone going quiet for prayer is legible in a single gesture.

records.title: Ṣād in Ink
records.description: One broad-nib ص, the opening letter of صلاة, carries the whole icon. The open counter holds its shape at small sizes.

records.title: Courtyard Light
records.description: A wedge of sunlight enters a mosque courtyard. Three arcade openings and a small corner tower give the plan its scale.

records.title: Blue Hour Door
records.description: Morning light falls through a half-open cobalt doorway. The paired leaves and brass studs recall Sidi Bou Said.

records.title: Night Folio
records.description: A crescent cuts into one page of an open Qur’an. The two broad leaves suggest night reading with very little detail.

records.title: Five Olive Leaves
records.description: Five leaves grow from one olive branch. The gold tip picks out the next prayer in the day.

records.title: Phone at Rest
records.description: A phone lies face down at the foot of a prayer mat. Its camera dot and the woven niche show the app’s quiet mode through a familiar action.

records.title: Brass Hours
records.description: An ivory sighting rule picks out one of five stations on a brass quadrant. The instrument connects the sun’s movement with prayer time.

records.title: Quiet Frequency · Low Sun
records.description: A small amber sun sits low inside the original two-wave arch.
records.keywords: round 9 new launcher proposals Low Sun

records.title: Quiet Frequency · Single Ripple
records.description: An earlier study with a single ripple leading into the prayer arch.
records.keywords: round 9 new launcher proposals Single Ripple

records.title: Android launcher
records.description: The phone app’s arch, Kairouan minaret, open Qur’an and mute badge. The compiled foreground identifies Round 3’s final teal design.

records.title: Google Play feature graphic
records.description: The current store lockup pairs the launcher with the Arabic and English app names.

records.title: Original Android launcher
records.description: White dome and two minarets on teal. The same early mark appears in the original design galleries.
records.source_note: Git snapshot cf6d51b2, before the November launcher change.

records.title: Original Google Play graphic
records.description: The earlier store banner pairs the original mosque art with the app wordmark.
records.source_note: Git snapshot cf6d51b2, before the November launcher change.

records.title: Desktop installer icon
records.description: The packaged desktop mark, supplied in PNG, Windows ICO and macOS ICNS formats.

records.title: Desktop window and tray
records.description: The desktop client draws this version with rounded minarets and a crescent constructed in Java2D.

records.title: Android TV launcher
records.description: A centered gold disc on the TV launcher’s dark teal field.

records.title: Android TV banner
records.description: A silver verse medallion and outlined Arabic wordmark on a dusk gradient.
records.source_note: Includes the earlier plain teal banner resource from Git e1cc1425.

records.title: Qaloon launcher
records.description: Its opaque white foreground color fills the adaptive icon. The green background is underneath.
